TERRESTRIAL PLANET / PLANET 04

Small facts. Big discoveries.

01

A volcano on another scale

Olympus Mons is the tallest volcano in our solar system, rising far above the surrounding Martian plains.

02

Rust gives Mars its color

Iron minerals in the soil oxidize. The same basic chemistry that creates rust gives Mars its reddish appearance.

03

An almost familiar day

A Martian day, called a sol, lasts about 24.6 hours—only a little longer than a day on Earth.
